payload.goal: Register the supplier Porto Alegre Lda with organization number 813918382 and email faktura@portoalegrelda.no in Tripletex.
success_checks: Supplier 'Porto Alegre Lda' is created in Tripletex
Supplier is active and retrievable via GET /supplier
risk_notes: Organization number 813918382 should be validated against the Norwegian Brønnøysund registry before creation
No phone number, address, or payment terms provided — may need to be added later
No bank account details provided for the supplier — required for payment processing
payload.suggested_first_action: POST /supplier with name='Porto Alegre Lda', organizationNumber='813918382', email='faktura@portoalegrelda.no'
ordered_steps: 1. Validate organization number 813918382 against Brønnøysund registry (optional but recommended)
2. POST /supplier with body: { name: 'Porto Alegre Lda', organizationNumber: '813918382', email: 'faktura@portoalegrelda.no' }
3. Confirm HTTP 201 response and capture supplierId from response
4. GET /supplier/{supplierId} to verify all fields are correctly stored

planned_endpoints.summary: Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
